questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Act 1 Scene 1, what does Benvolio try to do?
questions.why: Benvolio draws his sword to part the brawling servants, showing his peacemaking role, before Tybalt escalates the fight.

questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C–Am–F–G, which chord is built on the fourth scale degree?
questions.why: F is the 'IV' chord, built on the fourth note of the C major scale. A common mix-up is thinking Am (the 'vi') or G (the 'V') hold that role instead.

questions.subject: Visual Arts
questions.prompt: In 'Paint Like a Beast', what did students mainly use besides brushes to apply paint?
questions.why: Students experimented with fingers and sponges to create loose, expressive animal textures, rather than relying only on brushes.

questions.subject: Japanese
questions.why: 'Oishii' means delicious, used while eating. 'Itadakimasu' is said before eating, 'gochisousama' after, and 'mizu' means water.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these ranks in the feudal pyramid from highest to lowest power
questions.why: The Shogun held supreme military power, below him daimyo ruled domains, samurai served them, and peasants sat at the base.

questions.subject: History
questions.prompt: Order these steps of cause-and-consequence analysis from first to last
questions.why: Historians first identify the event, then find its multiple causes, before tracing its short-term and long-term consequences.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: Which character does Romeo love before he meets Juliet?
questions.why: Romeo is infatuated with Rosaline at the start of the play, before he even meets Juliet at the party. Students often forget this earlier crush existed and think Juliet was his first love.

questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: A classmate says Act 1 Scene 1 is 'just a fight scene' with no real purpose in the play. Explain what this misses about how the scene sets up the rest of Romeo and Juliet.
